title: Your Libra Sign Is Secretly Wrong
topic: Why your Libra sign is secretly wrong
mechanism: Sign dates were fixed over 2,000 years ago, but Earth's 26,000-year wobble slid the sky so the Sun now sits in Virgo during 'Libra season', and Libra itself was cut from the Scorpion's claws.

beats.hook: October first: your phone horoscope calls you perfectly balanced
beats.story: You buy the Libra mug and get a scales tattoo; the astronomer neighbour waves from her rooftop telescope
beats.rise: At your birthday party the friend shouts YOU ARE SO LIBRA
beats.twist: The astronomer walks into the party holding a star chart: the Sun was in Virgo
beats.mechanism: Calendar stamped LIBRA SEP 23-OCT 22; a spinning top labelled EARTH wobbling with a counter 26,000 YEARS; dial 1 DEGREE / 72 YEARS; sky wall with sun disc sliding onto VIRGO SEP 16-OCT 30 and LIBRA OCT 31; a giant scorpion whose claws a Roman snips off into scales, claw signs NORTHERN CLAW / SOUTHERN CLAW
beats.ending: Your Scorpio friend laughs; the astronomer says she is probably a Libra; she is already buying the mug

seed.what: The astronomer neighbour with her telescope

locations.set: Room cold + spinning top EARTH + counter
Room office + constellation wall + sun disc

red dress, curly brown hair, party cap
red tunic, gold cap (helmet), holding big scissors

gags.what: The tattoo needle buzzes and you jump off the chair
